script.spoken: An airliner crashed into the Atlantic off Nova Scotia. It had caught fire in flight, and all two hundred twenty nine aboard were killed. The crew smelled smoke in the cockpit. The fire was hidden above the ceiling. Arcing wires had ignited the insulation blankets there. The fire spread unseen and knocked out systems one by one. The jet went down before it could land. Flammable insulation was replaced across airliner fleets.
